# popnow-bot

> popnow-bot is a self-hosted Telegram and Discord bot for the PopNow API (https://popnow.ai). It generates AI images and videos, animates still images into video (image-to-video) and applies trending video effects inside chats, with a price quote before every paid run, confirmation above a threshold, per-person and whole-bot daily credit limits, and owner/allow lists. MIT licensed, TypeScript, Node.js 22.13+, runs with Docker.

## Commands
- /pic <prompt>: text-to-image
- /vid <prompt>: text-to-video
- /animate <motion>: reply to an image to turn it into a video; also an Animate button under each generated image
- /effect <name>, /effects: apply or list preset video effects (Tiny Planet, Hyperdrive, Liquid Chrome...); also an Effects button
- /models, /spend, /report, /help

## Setup
- git clone https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-bot.git, cp .env.example .env, set POPNOW_API_KEY (sk-popnow-...), TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and/or DISCORD_TOKEN, OWNER_ID
- docker compose up -d --build (the image is built locally)
- API keys: https://popnow.ai/api/console/keys

## PopNow API endpoints used (base https://api.popnow.ai)
- POST /api/v1/jobs/quote, POST /api/v1/jobs/createTask (quoteId, expectedCredits, Idempotency-Key), GET /api/v1/jobs/recordInfo
- GET /api/v1/models, GET /api/v1/models/{model}
- GET /api/v1/chat/credit (balance)
- POST /api/v1/common/upload-url, POST /api/v1/files/{fileId}/commit (popnow://f/... URIs)

## Key files
- src/core/flows.ts: quote, confirm, run and deliver
- src/core/media.ts: quote check, hold, submit, wait, settle
- src/core/ledger.ts: daily credit limits and holds
- src/core/effects.ts and effects/default.json: video effect presets
- src/telegram/bot.ts, src/discord/bot.ts: platform front ends

## Links
- Docs: https://popnow.ai/docs

- Pricing: https://popnow.ai/pricing (1 credit = $0.001, failed runs refunded)
